introduction.en: A synthetic-data experiment tested whether computer interaction could populate a simplified tax form.
introduction.zh: 一项使用模拟数据的实验测试电脑操作能否填写简化税表。

method.en: The tester created fictional W-2, 1099, 1098, property-tax and charity records in a folder shared with Claude computer use and a Mac.
method.zh: 测试者在Claude电脑操作与Mac共享的文件夹中放入虚构W-2、1099、1098、房产税和捐赠记录。

method.en: The target was a simplified Form 1040 in Firefox. Claude listed files and inspected screenshots, but had to be directed back to the prompt after asking for already supplied information.
method.zh: 目标是在Firefox中填写简化Form 1040；Claude列文件、检查截图，却重复询问已给信息，需要提醒重读指令。

outcome.en: The source excerpt stops when work on the form begins. The full linked blog is said to contain the accuracy results; those results are not established by this excerpt.
outcome.zh: 源站节选在开始填表时结束，并称准确性结果在所链接的完整博客中；本节选不能证明最终结果。

notes.en: A PDF-editor attempt failed, possibly because of compatibility according to the tester, so the task moved to a browser form. It was synthetic-data testing, not a real filing.
notes.zh: 先前PDF编辑器尝试失败，测试者怀疑兼容问题，因此改用网页表单；这是模拟资料测试，不是真实申报。
